sql.choice: SELECT t.id AS ident,t.a,t.b,t.c AS real_value,t.tag AS label,?3 AS bytes,?4 AS mixed FROM t WHERE t.a=?1 AND t.b IN (13,14) ORDER BY t.id
sql.force-a: SELECT t.id AS ident,t.a,t.b,t.c AS real_value,t.tag AS label,?3 AS bytes,?4 AS mixed FROM t INDEXED BY t_a WHERE t.a=?1 AND t.b IN (13,14) ORDER BY t.id
sql.force-ab: SELECT t.id AS ident,t.a,t.b,t.c AS real_value,t.tag AS label,?3 AS bytes,?4 AS mixed FROM t INDEXED BY t_ab WHERE t.a=?1 AND t.b IN (13,14) ORDER BY t.id
sql.dependency: SELECT t.id AS ident,t.c AS real_value,t.tag AS label,u.id AS matched,u.c AS rhs_real,?3 AS bytes,?4 AS mixed FROM t JOIN t AS u INDEXED BY t_ab ON u.a=t.a AND u.b=?2 WHERE t.a=?1 AND t.b IN (13,14) ORDER BY t.id,u.id
sql.left: SELECT t.id AS ident,t.c AS real_value,t.tag AS label,u.id AS matched,u.c AS rhs_real,?3 AS bytes,?4 AS mixed FROM t LEFT JOIN t AS u INDEXED BY t_ab ON u.a=t.a AND u.b=?2 AND u.id=t.id WHERE t.a=?1 AND t.b IN (13,14) ORDER BY t.id,u.id
